title: Stop one failing notification channel from re-sending all channels

source.note: Written by the repository author for v0.4.0 (repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: When the SMS gateway is down, customers receive the same 'order shipped' e-mail and push notification 5-6 times, because the failing job is retried as a whole. Stop the duplicates.
constraints: Notifications are best-effort; a lost SMS is acceptable, duplicate e-mails are not (spam complaints).
input.context: Notification worker (Node.js 20, ESM JavaScript with JSDoc types checked by tsc). notifyAll() fans out to e-mail, SMS and push; the job queue retries a job up to 5 times when the handler rejects.

ground_truth.notes: Tempting nitpick: demanding per-channel retries / an outbox for SMS (excluded: best-effort is the stated requirement).
